item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
You have this great concept here, great setup, minus Inyuyasha, great characters to draw from and use…

And it's just not as funny or as good as it could be.

Humor is especially subjective, so I can't say much. What I can say is that the whole of this just doesn't feel like it's doing anything other than giving you anime references and sidearming you while winking, hoping you get it. Just throwing characters with some dialog and saying "Do you recognize THIS name? Isn't this character in this position wacky?" doesn't work, and except for maybe Nagato's bit, nothing here is really that great or funny. The characterization of everyone (except Nagato and Ed) seem to be weird too, like the kind you'd see in fanfiction from someone who's only seen the series being referenced a few times.

But OK, it's meant to be not that great, right?

Yeah… this wasn't the most focused of stories, and that's probably it's biggest flaw. But that's what you get when you rush a story to keep up with the latest fad.

This isn't an excuse, really. It could be a lot more. But it's just… it's just not there. I want to love this, and I try my absolute hardest to like this, but there's no justification for me to do anything but downvote.

Also, that alternate ending is awful. Wouldn't change my downvote, but it'd be a step in the right direction to remove it.

EDIT: For what it's worth, the lolFoundation isn't a problem IMO. That's explainable by nature of it being a crossover or anime, and while lolFoundation isn't a core concept, it doesn't hold as much weight as any other factors. My other complaints still stand.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Funny thing, that. The original idea for this story came from a Code Geass crossover that I was going to write (but unfortunately never did). In one point of the story, Lelouch (the main character of Code Geass) had to break into a SCP Foundation Site located in Tokyo-2 to rescue someone infected by a modified strain of SCP-217 created by madwoman who was trying to create an army of robot soldiers. He does this by causing a mass containment breach, leading to Gendo Ikari (Director of the Site) having to team up with Dr. Clef, Dr. Freeman and Dr. Breen to fight their way out Left 4 Dead Style. And the Team Fortress guys would have been Task Force Theta-2 "Perfectly United Reconnisance PLatoon", and there would have been a 5-way fight between Edward Elric, Envy, 682, Abel, and Kamina.

Later I went back and redrew those plans; for one thing I made NERV a Foundation analogue instead of actually being a member of the Foundation, established a multiverse setting so that Dr. Clef and SCP-217 could still appear, and removed the big fight scene altogether. Everything else was kept though, and it's a real shame it never got written, as it probably would have been awesome. Or stupid. Or stupidly awesome.
